en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a hill densely covered with trees and rocky outcrops, topped by a large historic castle complex and adjacent town buildings. The castle has a high, multi-windowed main block with a steep hipped roof, and smaller attached structures; nearby are traditional town houses and a church tower. Printed text at the top reads in German: "Schloss und Stadt Wolkenstein".
